===Lore===

The Corrupter of Life is a skeletal being that possess the powers of a wizard, and it is thus easily mistaken as a lich or similar form of undead. Corrupters of Life are few, being high-ranking divine emissaries of the Prince of Hate, and they perform dark rituals all across Norrath for their master, most often seeking to corrupt the creations of the goddess Tunare. The Corrupter of Life uses its powers to corrupt various creatures, making them into horrid, twisted parodies of themselves. The intention is to turn the Wakening Lands from a verdant forest into a dark forest of predators which will spill into all the surrounding lands to spread hatred and strife.

Wearing black robes and wielding a massive and deadly scythe, the Corrupter of Life presents a formidable appearance. It emanates an aura of hatred, turning foes against one another by its mere presence.

Corrupters of Life speak the Dark Speech of their god as well as Common, although they most often communicate by telepathy with mortal beings.
